name: OpenClaw Exporter to Langfuse
description: Export OpenClaw AI agent execution traces to Langfuse via OpenTelemetry

headers.description: HTTP headers for OTLP authentication (Langfuse: Authorization)

tags.description: Custom Langfuse tags applied to the trace root span (e.g. ["id:openclaw", "ip:127.0.0.1"]).

batchSize.description: Number of spans to buffer before sending

flushIntervalMs.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait before sending buffered spans

enabledHooks.description: List of hooks to enable (if not set, all hooks are enabled)

skillsRoots.description: Explicit skill roots for skill tag detection. Highest priority; when set, auto-detection is skipped.

skillTaggingEnabled.description: Enable skill tag detection and emit skill:* tags to Langfuse tool observations.
